title: Disney’s Jollywood Nights 2026 Food Preview Includes Muppets Sundae and Popcorn Soda
excerpt: A Muppets sundae and popcorn soda headline an early look at Jollywood Nights dining, with menu details and availability worth watching.
author: LokkeeVerse
content:
A Muppets sundae and popcorn soda are among the food-and-drink highlights coming to Disney’s Jollywood Nights 2026 at Disney’s Hollywood Studios, according to wdwnt.com. The publisher reports that Disney Eats has shared six options, presenting the reveal in the style of a retro game show. The preview puts character-inspired desserts and an unusual beverage concept at the center of the holiday event’s dining conversation.

## Character Treats Meet Hollywood Nostalgia

Jollywood Nights is Disney’s separately ticketed holiday event at Hollywood Studios, combining seasonal entertainment with a setting rooted in show-business glamour. Food fits naturally into that approach: a themed snack can extend the atmosphere beyond a stage performance or decorated street. The retro game-show presentation gives this reveal a playful entertainment hook of its own.

The Muppets sundae brings a familiar Disney-associated cast into that mix, while popcorn soda draws on a snack closely connected with moviegoing. Those names offer a sense of the creative direction, but they should not be treated as complete descriptions. Ingredients, serving sizes and presentation will matter more than the novelty alone when guests decide what to order.

## What the Preview Means for Planning

For visitors considering an evening at Jollywood Nights, a food preview can help shape priorities before arrival. Separately ticketed events require guests to balance dining with shows, attractions and other experiences. Choosing a few must-try items in advance can make that balance easier, especially for anyone hoping to avoid spending too much of the evening moving between food locations.

The six-option announcement is best viewed as a preview rather than assumed to be the complete menu. Practical questions include where each item will be sold, whether availability is restricted to event hours and what dietary information Disney will provide. Guests with allergies should consult official ingredient guidance and speak with food-service staff rather than infer suitability from a product name or promotional image.

- **Featured concepts:** A Muppets sundae and popcorn soda.
- **Reveal format:** Six options introduced through a retro game-show theme.
- **Planning priorities:** Prices, locations, ingredients and serving hours.
- **Dietary checks:** Confirm suitability directly with Disney’s food-service team.

Watch next for a fuller Disney Eats menu and official event dining guidance. Those details will help readers distinguish eye-catching concepts from practical choices, compare potential purchases and decide how much of their Jollywood Nights evening to devote to seasonal food alongside the entertainment.
